title: File:Exit B of Qianmen Station (20210409130312).jpg
claims: The image shows the above-ground entrance of exit B at Qianmen station on Beijing Metro Line 2, with the blue line-and-station sign on the roof; the surrounding pavement is open and no race barrier or corral is visible.

Commons places the photograph at 39.898475N, 116.392953E and identifies it as exit B of Qianmen station; the scene is an ordinary station entrance, not a race-day start gate, athlete-entry checkpoint or closed-road layout.
